subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing label should OpenClaw use for the `google-vertex` provider while keeping the stable provider id and config/auth surfaces unchanged?
rationale: The source confirms stale visible copy, but choosing between Google-docs wording, the reporter's proposed wording, or retaining Vertex AI is a product/copy decision rather than a deterministic bug fix.

options.title: Use Google-docs bridge label
options.body: Update visible labels/docs to `Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)` or an approved close variant while preserving `google-vertex` as the stable id.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI for now
options.body: Leave current labels unchanged until Google and OpenClaw provider docs intentionally move away from Vertex AI naming.

options.title: Use reporter wording
options.body: Adopt `Google Enterprise AI` only if maintainers prefer the shorter name despite the current official page using different wording.

recommendation.title: Use Google-docs bridge label
recommendation.body: Update visible labels/docs to `Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)` or an approved close variant while preserving `google-vertex` as the stable id.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is primarily UI/docs/provider-label wording, and BunsDev is both connected to adjacent provider-contract work and named in the discussion for UI/UX/docs routing.
